items.title: Post action row: controls left, cluster + total right
items.precondition: Signed in; Feed with a post that has at least one reaction
steps: Confirm left group is react trigger then comment icon
Confirm right side shows clustered reaction sticker(s) and one total number
items.expected: [react][comment] …… [cluster][total]; no count chip between react and comment.
items.evidence: Human reviewed Feed on http://localhost:5180 during execution/continue; confirmed right-side cluster + total layout.

items.title: Multiple reaction types cluster with a single total
items.precondition: A post (or comment) has two or more different reaction types
steps: Confirm each present type shows as an icon in the right cluster
Confirm only one number appears — the sum of all reactions
items.expected: Cluster of distinct stickers + one total; no ❤️2 👍1 style chips.
items.evidence: Human tuned right-cluster emoji size on localhost with multi-type summaries visible.

items.title: Zero reactions hides the right summary
items.precondition: Signed in; a post with no reactions (or clear your only reaction)
steps: View a post with total reactions = 0
Confirm the right cluster/total is not shown
Confirm react trigger + comment icon remain on the left
items.expected: No empty cluster or "0" on the right when total is 0.
items.evidence: Code: ReactionBar renders summary only when totalCount > 0; human exercised feed with reacted and unreacted posts.

items.title: Comment / reply rows match the same layout
items.precondition: Signed in on a post with comments; at least one reacted comment
steps: On a parent comment with reactions: confirm [react][reply] …… [cluster][total]
On a reply with reactions: confirm [react] …… [cluster][total]
items.expected: Same ReactionBar layout rules on comment threads.
items.evidence: PostDetailPage wires ReplyActionButton as ReactionBar actions; replies use ReactionBar alone — same component as Feed.
items.notes: Human visual focus was Feed; comment/reply parity via shared ReactionBar.

items.title: Set / switch / clear still works
steps: Add a reaction — right summary appears/updates
Switch to another reaction — cluster/total update
Clear the reaction — if total hits 0, summary hides
items.expected: Picker UX and API behavior unchanged; layout updates with summary.
items.evidence: API mutation path unchanged; human interacted with reactions on localhost while sizing the right cluster.

items.title: Messages reactions unchanged
steps: Confirm message reaction UI still shows prior layout (not this plan’s right-cluster row)
items.expected: Messages reaction chips not redesigned by this plan.
items.evidence: git diff: MessagesPage.tsx not modified in this plan.
